entities.summary: Nasser Mohammadifar was a brigadier general of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army who served as the Supreme Military Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Iran and Supreme Leader, Ali Khamenei. He was the 14th Commander-in-Chief of the Iranian Army Ground Forces from 2001 to 2005.
